explanation: Reviewed all 17 changed paths and reconciled all 33 prior findings against the exact packet identity: repo=/Users/ian/Projects/ClimbingApp; branch=loop/boarded-v1-20260905-78720d/web; base_sha=9a68ff18ffd612b21bfb5173a50b82ee7c35297e; head_sha=964882a47f13fcdb09efb5632f41e44328663faf; diff_sha256=a6ff21779800931e863997dec68e48ec8af07a3c1202cfee2f2f1b0e398d6345; packet_spec_sha256=e2224419bcb6937dd4a39ea54dd04ebe8b2ae78b3811db7a62b56f25864d7498; dependency_heads={}; target_snapshot_sha256=1bac819114077fb4af8ef93d4031a0597fa24a7286fc2dd589a04026c3a71145; confinement_sha256=59134791df57b4f8f10d03f776c2b8ffda03e90139c090b1532afa8682a099f8. The full-index binary diff hash matches, but compilation, publication/recovery, privacy isolation, and destination interactions still contain material defects. No edits, builds, tests, linters, formatters, or browser actions were performed; runtime/render approval remains with Main.

findings.title: Remove the unsupported RouteList creation prop
findings.body: Explore still passes onNewRoute to RouteList, but the unchanged RouteListProps accepts only routes, onViewRoute, onLogClimb, onDeleteRoute, and onEditRoute. This produces a TypeScript excess-prop error independently of the pending shared dependency and prevents the web build.

findings.title: Break the Profile posts effect's self-triggering fetch loop
findings.body: fetchUserPosts depends on userPosts, while the effect at lines 305–309 depends on fetchUserPosts and calls it with true. Every response creates a new posts array, recreates the callback, and starts another first-page request; errors also assign a fresh empty array. The default posts tab continuously requests data, and loading older posts immediately triggers a reset to page one.

findings.title: Render only one factual overlay for composed post artwork
findings.body: resolvedImageUrl loads item.image_path, which both publication implementations use for the flattened result card; the new web composer burns the scrim, outcome, route, grade, venue, and presentation into those pixels. FeedCard then unconditionally paints another scrim and factual shelf over that image. Use the source-image sibling for live overlays or suppress the live shelf when displaying the composed image.

findings.title: Load the selected ended session's attempts before publication
findings.body: Past Sessions and SessionDetailModal call handleOpenFinishModal(session), but this function selects from the page's active-session attempts array rather than loading the supplied session. After a private save or hard reload, that array is empty, so the featured-climb selector has no options and Publish remains disabled. The modal's separately loaded attempts are never passed back, leaving the advertised resumable publication flow unusable.

findings.title: Reconcile the ended session immediately after its update succeeds
findings.body: If ending the session succeeds but session_posts insertion fails, neither activeSession nor sessionToPublish receives the persisted ended_at. Cancelling the composer therefore returns to a Live Session and permits additional logging after its recorded end; retrying also overwrites the end time because target.ended_at remains null. Preserve the successful end transition independently of publication success and retry from that ended state.

findings.title: Reconcile uncertain post insertion before deleting its artwork
findings.body: A post insert can commit on the server while its response is lost. This branch treats every returned error as proof that no post exists and removes both uploaded images; after connectivity recovers, it can therefore leave a valid public session_posts row pointing to deleted artwork. The next retry allocates another post ID and conflicts with session_posts.session_id's unique constraint. Retain the operation identity and check whether that post committed before cleanup or retry.

findings.title: Retain failed public-upload cleanup for retry
findings.body: Storage remove returns an error in its result, but both cleanup calls ignore that result and the catch also discards failures. If removal fails after an upload or post error, uploadedKeys exists only in this invocation and is forgotten when the user cancels, saves privately, or navigates away. The photograph and composed card remain in the publicly readable bucket without a post or recoverable cleanup record.

findings.title: Guard Log mutation completions against identity changes
findings.body: The fetch path checks activeUserIdRef, but handleStartSession and handleLogAttempt do not. If a start request completes after logout in another tab, this setter repopulates activeSession after the logout effect cleared it; the unguarded JSX then displays its private conditions and notes while signed out. A delayed attempt response can likewise append account A's private record into account B's current session. Scope mutation completions and session drafts to the initiating identity.

findings.title: Close private Profile inspectors when the viewer changes
findings.body: Logout clears the session arrays but not inspectingSession, and SessionDetailModal remains mounted solely according to that retained object. Opening a private session and signing out in another tab therefore leaves its notes, conditions, and loaded attempts visible. Direct account switches also skip this entire clearing branch, retaining the previous owner's private statistics and selections. Clear identity-scoped selections and require the current owner when rendering them.

findings.title: Reject inbox responses belonging to an obsolete account
findings.body: Changing user.id starts another fetchActivity request but does not invalidate the earlier one. If account A's initial or continuation response arrives after account B's request, these setters replace or append A's recipient-only notifications into B's inbox and clear its loading state. Capture the request identity/generation and reject obsolete response and mutation completions.

findings.title: Refresh and clear Explore data on authentication changes
findings.body: The route effect omits user.id, and the venue/climber fetch callbacks likewise depend only on search text. Authentication hydration therefore leaves anonymous bookmark/follow flags unchanged, while signing out or switching accounts with Bookmarks Only selected leaves account A's saved-route list rendered without an auth guard. Include viewer identity in request invalidation and clear account-scoped results and open selections before replacement queries.

findings.title: Preserve the targeted post across initial feed replacement
findings.body: Opening /app#post-ID starts the first-page request and post_filter request independently. If the target resolves first, it is prepended, but this later first-page assignment removes it whenever it lies outside the current feed; the scheduled scroll may also execute while loading skeletons hide every post. Coordinate target resolution with initial loading or render the target separately so shared and inbox links reliably open their actual post.

findings.title: Invalidate Feed continuation requests when its query changes
findings.body: Unlike loadInitial, fetchFeed has no cancellation or generation guard. Starting Load older sends in Discovery and then switching to Following allows the late Discovery response to append unrelated posts to the new followed feed, replace hasMore, and supply the next cursor. The same path can append viewer-specific state from an earlier account. Bind continuation results to the originating mode and identity.

findings.title: Dispatch Feed outdoor routes to the outdoor detail consumer
findings.body: Feed's Beta action always assigns Route and renders RouteViewerDialog, including for outdoor routes returned by the new feed projection. That unchanged consumer applies V-scale calculateDisplayGrade and a wall canvas, with /walls/demo-wall.jpg as this page's fallback. An outdoor YDS/Font climb consequently loses its grade and physical/venue metadata and can display an unrelated board instead of the outdoor detail view already used by Explore.

findings.title: Normalize deep-linked route rows before opening their details
findings.body: The direct routes query does not return CommunityRoute.is_saved or image_url, yet its row is cast to that projection. A previously bookmarked outdoor route opened through routeId is therefore shown as unsaved and cannot be correctly toggled. For board routes that rely on their walls.image_url rather than a route snapshot, the missing wall join also makes the viewer fall back to the selected or demo wall. Resolve the canonical viewer-specific projection and actual image rather than casting the database row.

findings.title: Update the open route modal's bookmark state
findings.body: OutdoorRouteDetailModal reads route.is_saved from activeOutdoorRouteToView, but handleToggleBookmark updates only the routes array. After saving in the modal, it still says Save and a second activation again inserts rather than removing; an initially saved route similarly remains visually saved after deletion. Update or derive the selected route from the same state on success, optimistic changes, and rollback.

findings.title: Preserve the route's grade system in the Log handoff
findings.body: Explore sends discipline and grade_label but omits grade_system, and Log infers the system only from discipline. Selecting a Font boulder such as 7A therefore prefills its real label under v_scale and persists the wrong grading system unless the user manually corrects it; custom grades are also not representable in Log's selector. Carry and consume the canonical grade_system rather than guessing from discipline.

findings.title: Clear the catalog link when entering a different manual climb
findings.body: linkedRouteId is set from the URL and never cleared anywhere, while the route name, grade, and discipline remain freely editable. After logging linked route A, entering a different manual climb B still inserts A's route_id. Publishing B then exposes A's route metadata, Beta target, and bookmark action. Detach the link when changing away from the selected catalog climb or provide an explicit route-selection/unlink control.

findings.title: Leave unknown route facts unset instead of publishing defaults
findings.body: A new route starts with an actual 5.11a grade and vertical terrain, and changing discipline substitutes V4; these are submitted as public facts without user input. Terrain has no unknown option and grade is required despite both fields being nullable in the contract. Initialize factual metadata as unset and require an actual value or persist null, rather than manufacturing grades and terrain for newly named climbs.

findings.title: Finish pagination for saved routes and publishable session history
findings.body: Profile still requests only the first 30 saved routes and provides no continuation control, so older bookmarks remain inaccessible from Saved. Log likewise caps pastSessions at 20 without continuation, which also limits the only page that supplies the session publication callback. Complete these bounded lists rather than treating their first page as the full journal or ticklist.

findings.title: Load private progress independently of the selected Profile tab
findings.body: ownerPrivateAttempts is populated only when the user selects Private Sessions, but Best Send, Total Sends, and the grade distribution consume it on the other tabs as well. The default Posts tab therefore shows zero private sends and no private best, and the values change merely by visiting another tab. Fetch the owner's progress data when the profile loads rather than gating it behind session-history navigation.

findings.title: Rank private grades within their canonical grading systems
findings.body: The new private send labels are sorted with gradeToNumber, which accepts only V-scale values and returns -1 for every YDS or Font grade. For a sport-only climber with 5.10a and 5.13a sends, Best Send follows query order rather than difficulty; mixed disciplines are also collapsed into one incomparable ranking. Use the canonical system-aware grade/statistics utilities and keep bests separated by the appropriate system.

findings.title: Keep the flash-rate numerator and denominator in the same domain
findings.body: The numerator counts only public ascent ticks marked flashed, while the new denominator includes every private attempt. A climber with one flashed public tick has 100% until merely loading ten unrelated private attempts, which changes the same public flash rate to about 9%. Keep public tick flash rate separate from private session send statistics unless both numerator and denominator have matching supported semantics.

findings.title: Scope all Profile completions to the current profile target
findings.body: The profile lookup has a generation guard, but fetchUserPosts and this follow-error rollback do not. Following A, navigating to B, and receiving A's delayed failure restores A's entire otherProfile object beneath B's URL; a delayed posts response can likewise replace B's posts with A's. Apply target/identity guards to mutation rollback and post-loading completions, not only the initial identity query.

findings.title: Make private session inspection keyboard-operable
findings.body: Profile's only session-inspection action is an onClick on a div with no keyboard semantics, and its trailing Inspect Tries indicator is a span. Log's past-session Details action has the same structure. Keyboard and switch users therefore cannot reopen saved attempt history even though pointer users can; use semantic inspection controls without swallowing the separate Publish action.

findings.title: Keep nested route actions out of the card's keyboard handler
findings.body: The card-level onKeyDown receives bubbling Enter/Space events from its nested Bookmark and Log Try buttons. It prevents their default activation and opens route details instead, while those child buttons stop only click propagation. Keyboard users therefore cannot activate the advertised direct actions. Handle only events targeting the card itself or use separate semantic navigation and action controls.

findings.title: Measure the grade using its actual export font
findings.body: The grade is drawn at 72px Cormorant, but ctx.font is changed to 24px system sans before measureText determines the venue's starting position. For ordinary multi-character labels such as 5.12a, this measures a substantially narrower string and places the venue inside the grade's drawn extent. Measure before changing fonts or place the venue in a separately bounded row so the uploaded artwork does not overlap its core facts.

findings.title: Preview the composed crop and facts before publishing
findings.body: photoPreviewUrl is the original file's object URL and is shown only as a 64px square thumbnail; composition runs for the first time inside handlePublishToFeed and immediately uploads a center-cropped 4:5 image with additional facts. Neither the chosen Stats/Timeline treatment nor the actual exported crop is previewed, so users cannot inspect what they are about to publish. Generate and display the same composed artifact before the publication action.

findings.title: Generate image alt text from the actual attempt outcome
findings.body: The composer permits a featured attempt whose outcome is fell or stopped, but imageAlt always says that the climb was sent. FeedCard uses this value directly as its image alternative, so assistive technology receives a false successful result for those posts. Derive the alternative from featuredAtt.outcome and the facts actually depicted.

findings.title: Preserve an ended session's original finish timestamp
findings.body: The newly added history Publish action opens this same composer for an already-ended session. Choosing Save Privately Only then unconditionally replaces ended_at with now, extending an old session by hours or days and changing its duration/history even though the user only declined publication. Skip the end mutation for an already-ended target.

findings.title: Distinguish failed private-session reads from empty history
findings.body: An active-session query error falls through to clearing activeSession and attempts, while attempt/history errors are ignored; SessionDetailModal also converts an errored attempts result into an empty list. An offline or rejected read therefore presents Start Session or No attempts recorded instead of a recoverable failure and can prompt another session creation despite an existing live session. Preserve an explicit unknown/error state and offer retry rather than asserting missing records.

findings.title: Allow saved attempt notes to be read in full
findings.body: SessionDetailModal is the only web inspection view for saved attempt notes, but it places the entire note in a single truncated metadata line with no expansion, tooltip, or secondary detail action. A normal multi-sentence note therefore becomes permanently unreadable to sighted users after saving the session. Let the private detail view wrap or expand the stored note instead of applying the compact timeline truncation to its only full-history view.
